sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01. 2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Addl.
Standing counsel for the State.
3.

The petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with Bargarh rural P.S. Case No. 234 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No. 63 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned ADJ-Cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Bargarh for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 376(3)/323/294/450/506/34 of IPC.
4. Though one of the alleged offences is Section 376(3) of IPC yet, the allegations of sexual assault are against one Chandan Mohapatra.
The petitioners are his mother and sister.
There is no allegation as such of any sexual assault against them.

The Anticipatory Bail application is therefore,
held to be maintainable.
5. Having regard to the nature of accusations and the materials on record, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioners to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
